sources.locator: 3.1 introductory discussion; 3.1.2.4 Cross-validation iterators for grouped data; 3.1.2.4.1 Group K-fold
sources.short_excerpt: Such a grouping of data is domain specific. [...] To measure this, we need to ensure that all the samples in the validation fold come from groups that are not represented at all in the paired training fold.
sources.inspection_note: 已讀官方原文：相依資料的group定義依領域而定；group互斥用於測未見群組；反覆依test表現調參會洩漏，validation供開發、test留最終評估。這支持本節契約，但不證明任何實際B/C資料已正確切分。

sources.version: Lake & Baroni, ICML 2018, PMLR 80:2873–2882, proceedings PDF
sources.locator: Experiment 1: PDF p.3; Experiment 2: PDF p.4; Experiment 3: PDF p.5
sources.short_excerpt: The training set provides broad coverage of the task space, and the test set examines how networks can decompose and recombine commands from the training set. [...] We study next a more systematic form of generalization, where models must bootstrap to commands requiring longer action sequences than those seen in training.
sources.inspection_note: 實讀三種切分的設計：隨機未見命令、較長動作序列、僅見primitive後的組合。只取評估目標與切分設計的對應，不搬用論文accuracy或推論本課模型效果。

sources.short_excerpt: Each method requires a hold-out validation set, which in practice can be the same set used for hyperparameter tuning. [...] T is optimized with respect to NLL on the validation set.
sources.inspection_note: 已讀原文validation用途與溫度T估計位置。論文容許與調參共用validation；本節另分calibration與policy是較保守的專案設計，非宣稱論文普遍要求二者必須分開。候選全文14.17-guo.pdf與本次從PMLR自行下載19.14-guo.pdf的SHA-256一致。
